تستخبرون (form X)
# تَسْتَخْبِرُونَ (tastaḵbirūna) /tas.tax.bi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
# تُسْتَخْبَرُونَ (tustaḵbarūna) /tus.tax.ba.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَخْبَرَ (istaḵbara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
